description: Lemniscate under encoder measurement noise plus a periodic differential wheel-torque disturbance. Corresponds to the paper's Fig. 23 controller comparison, run 'under the same conditions and with the presence of measured noise', and exercises the FUHAC disturbance observer. Paper Table 3 ordering for this case: PID ISE 14.7 > SMC 9.0 > FUHAC 3.7 > Backstepping 3.3 (FUHAC preferred over pure backstepping on torque chattering, not on raw ISE).
